story_conventions.reserved_helper: An expected error overrides RESERVED status; errors carry no success result. No success and error simultaneously.
story_conventions.committed_helper: An expected error/expectedtransport overrides COMMITTED status; formal freeze normalizer must drop helper default status for errors.

story_conventions.canonical_binding_vectors: 24 decoded-object tests; accepted canonical bytes/hash computed independently before qualification. Raw lexical rejection is not inferred after SDK normalization.
story_conventions.concurrent_refusal_unchanged_scope: For requests dispatched before an unrelated winner commits, unchanged means no durable transition, reservation or business effect attributable to the rejected operation. Global SQL may advance due to the winner. The after-admission checkpoint and request-correlated transition/hook records distinguish these effects; never compare the whole pending RPC before/after revision as unchanged.
